title.en: Answering the Phone and Taking Messages

scene.ko: 거래처에서 걸려 온 전화를 받아 이름 · 용건 · 전화번호를 받아 적고 다시 불러 확인한다.

lines.en: Good afternoon, Dasol Tech. This is Jiho speaking.
alt: Dasol Tech, Jiho speaking. How can I help you?

lines.en: Hi, this is Karen Mills from Ferngate Supply. Is Sora Han available?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 펀게이트 서플라이의 캐런 밀스입니다. 한소라 씨 통화 가능하실까요?

lines.en: I'm afraid she's out of the office today. Would you like to leave a message?
lines.ko: 죄송하지만 오늘 사무실에 안 계세요. 메시지 남기시겠어요?
alt: Sorry, she's not in the office today. Can I take a message?
She's out today, I'm afraid. May I take a message?

lines.en: Yes, please. It's about the delivery date for your next order.
lines.ko: 네, 부탁드려요. 다음 주문 건 배송 날짜 때문에요.

lines.en: All right. Could I have your phone number, please?
alt: Okay. What's the best number to reach you?
Sure. Can I get your phone number?

lines.en: Let me read that back to you. 555-0142, extension 3?
alt: Let me repeat that. 555-0142, extension 3, right?

lines.en: That's right. She can call me anytime before five.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 5시 전이면 언제든 전화 주셔도 돼요.

lines.en: Got it. I'll make sure she gets your message first thing tomorrow.
lines.ko: 알겠습니다. 내일 아침에 출근하시면 바로 메시지 전해 드릴게요.
alt: Okay. I'll pass your message on to her first thing tomorrow.
Understood. She'll get your message tomorrow morning.

expressions.en: I'm afraid she's out of the office.
expressions.note: out of the office = 외근 · 출장 등으로 자리에 없는

expressions.en: Would you like to leave a message?
expressions.note: Can I take a message? 도 같은 뜻

expressions.en: Let me read that back to you.
expressions.note: 받아 적은 번호 · 이름을 확인할 때
